gloss: to occur one after another; to happen in succession

definitions.gloss: to occur one after another; to happen in succession; to break out repeatedly
definitions.explanation: For incidents, accidents, or problems to happen one after another in a series. Almost always used for negative events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Accidents are happening one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{窃盗|せっとう}→窃盗：15280_settou⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Theft incidents have been occurring one after another in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}した⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{保健所|ほけんじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{出|だ}した→乗り出す：05760_noridasu⟧。
examples.english: After food poisoning cases occurred in succession, the health center launched an investigation.

notes:
Composed of {続|ぞく} (continue, follow) + ⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (occur, emit). Used almost exclusively for negative events — accidents, crimes, disasters, and problems happening in series.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}する: accidents occur in succession
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}する: incidents happen one after another
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}する: damage occurs repeatedly
- ⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続発|ぞくはつ}する: troubles keep arising

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{連発|れんぱつ}する→連発する：21028_renpatsusuru⟧: to occur in rapid succession — can be positive or negative; emphasizes rapid repetition
- ⟦{頻発|ひんぱつ}する→頻発する：22178_hinpatsusuru⟧: to occur frequently — emphasizes high frequency rather than sequential occurrence
- ⟦{相次|あいつ}ぐ→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧: to follow one after another — similar meaning and nuance, slightly more literary

REGISTER:
Common in news reports and formal writing. Typically appears in headlines and news stories about crime, accidents, and public health issues.
